metadata.title: [FIX][UI]: Preserve tab, team_id, and proxy prefix across admin mutations
metadata.author: madhav165

description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

## 📌 Summary

Fixes admin UI losing tab context (`#fragment`), `team_id`, and proxy prefix after add/edit/delete/toggle operations when embedded in an iframe behind a server-side proxy.

Closes #3321, Closes #3324

## 🔁 Reproduction Steps

1. Embed admin UI in an iframe via proxy route (e.g. `/api/proxy/mcp/admin?team_id=...#gateways`)
2. Perform any mutation (add/edit/delete/toggle a gateway, server, tool, etc.)
3. **Before fix:** URL loses proxy prefix, `team_id`, `include_inactive`, and/or `#fragment` — user lands on wrong tab with wrong scope
4. **After fix:** All URL context is preserved

## 🐞 Root Cause

Two independent issues:

1. **Add/edit handlers** (#3324): Used `window.ROOT_PATH` to build redirect URLs. In proxy-embedded deployments, `ROOT_PATH` is empty (ASGI `root_path` not forwarded), so navigation went to `/admin` instead of `/proxy/mcp/admin`.

2. **Delete/toggle handlers** (#3321): Used native `form.submit()` which triggered 303 redirects. The browser followed the redirect server-side through the proxy, losing the iframe's URL context (fragment, query params, proxy prefix).

## 💡 Fix Description

1. **`_navigateAdmin()` helper** — New proxy-aware navigation function that derives the admin base from `window.location.pathname` (finding `/admin` and preserving everything before it as the proxy prefix) rather than relying on `window.ROOT_PATH`.

2. **All 15 add/edit success handlers** converted from `window.location.href = \`\${window.ROOT_PATH}/admin...#tab\`` to `_navigateAdmin(fragment, searchParams)`.

3. **`handleToggleSubmit` converted to `fetch()`** with `redirect: 'manual'` so the browser doesn't follow the 303 redirect. After the mutation succeeds, navigates via `_navigateAdmin()`.

4. **`include_inactive` preservation** — `_navigateAdmin()` carries `include_inactive=true` when the show-inactive checkbox is checked, and omits it otherwise (no injection of params that weren't originally present).

### Handlers converted (15 total)
- **Add:** gateways, servers, tools, resources, prompts, A2A agents, gRPC services
- **Edit:** gateways, servers, tools, resources, prompts, A2A agents
- **Toggle/delete:** `handleToggleSubmit` (all entity types)

## 🧪 Verification

17 new Playwright regression tests across 3 test classes:

| Class | Tests | Coverage |
|-------|-------|----------|
| `TestAdminUrlContextPreservation` | +4 | `include_inactive` round-trips; single-param no-bleed |
| `TestAdminProxyUrlContext` | +6 | Proxy prefix `/proxy/mcp` survives add/edit/toggle/delete |
| `TestAdminIframeContext` | +7 | Same guarantees inside an `<iframe>` with proxy routing |

Proxy simulation uses `page.route()` to intercept `/proxy/mcp/**` requests. Iframe tests build an inline host page with `page.set_content()` and strip `X-Frame-Options` headers.

## 📐 MCP Compliance (if relevant)
- [x] No MCP protocol changes — UI-only fix
- [x] No breaking change to MCP clients

## ✅ Checklist
- [x] Code formatted
- [x] No secrets/credentials committed
- [x] Regression tests added
- [x] Works in direct, proxy, and iframe-embedded deployments

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body: Reviewed and approved. All code changes are sound — _navigateAdmin() correctly derives proxy prefix, handleToggleSubmit fetch conversion preserves CSRF/auth, all 15 call sites converted consistently, no security issues. Added review fixes: lastIndexOf for robustness, correct test selectors, DOM-click edit tests, registered pytest markers, and direct-mode edit test for full mutation coverage.

commits.message:
fix(ui): use _navigateAdmin() in add/edit handlers to preserve proxy prefix

Replaces all 13 occurrences of window.ROOT_PATH/admin#fragment with
_navigateAdmin() calls. Preserves team_id and tab context when the admin
UI is embedded behind a proxy that does not forward ASGI root_path.

Closes #3324

Signed-off-by: Madhav Kandukuri <madhav165@gmail.com>
commits.author: Madhav Kandukuri

commits.message:
fix(ui): convert handleToggleSubmit to fetch() to prevent 303 redirect context loss

Replaces form.submit() with async fetch(redirect:'manual') so the
browser never follows the 303 redirect to the backend-direct URL.
After the mutation, _navigateAdmin() navigates to the correct proxy-
scoped URL preserving team_id and tab fragment.

Updates test assertion to reflect the new inline CSRF injection via
FormData.set() rather than the injectCsrfTokenIntoForm() DOM helper.

Closes #3321

Signed-off-by: Madhav Kandukuri <madhav165@gmail.com>

commits.message:
fix(ui): harden _navigateAdmin and stabilize Playwright tests

- Use lastIndexOf("/admin") instead of indexOf to avoid false matches
  on path segments like /administrator in proxy prefix detection.
- Register regression, proxy, iframe pytest markers in pyproject.toml
  to suppress PytestUnknownMarkWarning.
- Wait for editGateway global to be defined before calling it in proxy
  and iframe edit tests (admin.js is 1.2 MB, networkidle can fire
  before script execution completes).
- Wrap iframe proxy route handler in try/except to prevent
  "Route is already handled" errors during teardown.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
test(playwright): add direct-mode edit gateway test for full mutation coverage

Adds test_edit_gateway_preserves_gateways_fragment_and_team_id to
TestAdminUrlContextPreservation so the direct (non-proxy) class covers
all four mutation types: add, edit, toggle, and delete.

Closes coverage gap identified during review.

commits.message:
fix(test): correct form selectors and use DOM clicks for edit tests

- Fix _fill_add_gateway_form selectors: target #add-gateway-form
  #mcp-server-name / #mcp-server-url (actual element IDs) instead of
  #gateway-name / input[id*='gateway'] which matched the hidden edit
  modal and caused 60s timeouts on fill().
- Replace page.evaluate("editGateway(...)") with DOM button click
  in all 3 edit tests (direct, proxy, iframe). The 1.2 MB admin.js
  may not finish executing before networkidle fires, making the
  global function unavailable for evaluate(). Clicking the edit
  button via locator waits naturally for the element to be
  actionable.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
